
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Improve digit display and NA display for kable tables
options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = "")

# Load necessary packages
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(quantmod)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Getting started

```{r}
# Microsoft
# 5 days before, closing price

microsoft_stock <- getSymbols("MSFT", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-03-26", to = "2026-04-05") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(MSFT), coredata(MSFT)) |>
  select(Date, MSFT.Close)

alphabet_stock <- getSymbols("GOOG", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-06-27", to = "2026-07-02") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(GOOG), coredata(GOOG)) |>
  select(GOOG.Close)

meta_stock <- getSymbols("META", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-09-27", to = "2026-10-02") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(META), coredata(META)) |>
  select(META.Close)

apple_stock <- getSymbols("AAPL", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-06-25", to = "2026-06-30") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(AAPL), coredata(AAPL)) |>
  select(AAPL.Close)

nvidia_stock <- getSymbols("NVDA", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-07-24", to = "2026-07-30") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(NVDA), coredata(NVDA)) |>
  select(NVDA.Close)

tesla_stock <- getSymbols("TSLA", src = "yahoo", from = "2025-09-27", to = "2026-10-02") |>
  data.frame(Date = index(TSLA), coredata(TSLA)) |>
  select(TSLA.Close)

ten_qs <- read_csv("data/scraped-10qs.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: time-series

ggplot(data=microsoft_stock, aes(x = ))
```

```{r}
#| label: dot-plot

ggplot(data = ten_qs, aes(color = COMP, x = COMP, y = RD)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  labs(color = "Company")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-layout
#| tbl-cap: "Two tables side-by-side"
#| tbl-subcap: 
#|   - "First three rows of cars dataset"
#|   - "First three rows of pressure dataset"
#| layout-ncol: 2

cars |> 
  slice(1:3) |> 
  kable()

pressure |> 
  slice(1:3) |> 
  kable()
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-layout
#| fig-cap: "Three figures in a complex layout"
#| fig-subcap: 
#|   - "cars"
#|   - "pressure"
#|   - "mtcars"
#| layout: [[4, -1, 4], [1]] 

ggplot(cars, aes(speed, dist)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(pressure, aes(temperature, pressure)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(mtcars, aes(hp, mpg)) +
  geom_point()
```
